test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Sensitive
solution: The correct answer is: "**Numb**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • "**Sensitive**" means easily affected or influenced by external factors. (बाहरी कारकों से आसानी से प्रभावित या प्रभावित होना) • **Example**: *He was known for his sensitive nature and always empathized with others' feelings.* • Marked option "**Numb**" is the opposite of sensitive and means lacking in feeling or responsiveness. (भावना या प्रतिक्रिया की कमी) • **Example**: *The anaesthesia made his entire arm feel numb, and he couldn't feel any pain during the surgery.* • Other possible antonyms for "Sensitive" could be "Insensitive", "Unfeeling", or "Callous". Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ • **Understanding **means having empathy or comprehension. (सहानुभूति या समझ होना) • **Precise **means exact or accurate. (सटीक) • **Diplomatic **means tactful or skilled in handling delicate situations. (नाजुक परिस्थितियों से निपटने में चतुर या कुशल) 1c6:T529,The correct answer is: "**Fail to take advantage of an opportunity.**"
